added.name: Elithia
added.long_description:
US workers' compensation paid out $64.1 billion in 2023. Personal injury, malpractice, and other insurance claims add billions more. Behind every one of these claims sit thousands of pages of medical records, and a clinician spends hours or days reading them to reconstruct what happened to the patient.

Elithia is building agents to do this work.

Our agents reconstruct patient histories, reason across conflicting evidence, and produce defensible analyses, with every finding cited to the original record.

We've sold to physician expert witnesses and medical-legal firms, turning thousands of pages into court-ready chronologies an expert can verify in minutes. Next: TPAs and insurers, where the same review sits behind every injury claim.
added.one_liner: Agents for the medical review behind every claim

added.name: BioDelivera
added.long_description: BioDelivera has developed proprietary GCV™, a drug delivery platform designed to travel through the body and selectively target diseased cells while sparing healthy ones. GCVs can carry genetic medicines, DNA, RNA, small molecules, or combinations of these at the same time. BioDelivera has demonstrated efficacy in tumors, muscle, and brain and is expanding to additional tissues. The company’s mission is to enable cures for every patient, across every disease.
added.one_liner: Programmable drug delivery precisely targets only diseased cells

long_description.before:
Definite connects operational data with finance so businesses that make, move, build, or operate things can see how the way they run shows up in their numbers.

These businesses already record a lot: production runs, shipments, job sites, equipment hours, work orders. Finance records the same business in a different shape. Operating systems track activity by site, line, or day. The ledger tracks it by entity, account, and month. Both sets of records exist, but the link between an operating decision and its financial effect usually lives in spreadsheets and in a few people's heads.

So questions that should be routine take days. What happens to cash if one plant adds a shift? How does a change in throughput or staffing flow into the forecast? Which operating changes actually moved the numbers last quarter?

Definite connects to existing operational and financial systems read-only. Models propose how operational records map to financial ones and explain what they find. Deterministic rules perform the calculations and checks, so results trace back to the source records they came from. We never write back to your systems.

We met studying at the University of Waterloo. Gurshabd worked at BitGo, where proofs that customer assets matched the ledger were built by hand. Farhan built machine learning systems at Meta. Mazin worked at Optiver, then built LLM agents for financial analysts at Boosted.ai, where he saw that finance teams won't act on a number they can't trace to its source.
long_description.after:

long_description.before:
Industrial and legacy enterprises still rely on people to coordinate disconnected layers of software and machines.

Faraday builds self-improving systems that take on this operational work. We connect to existing software and machines and build training and evaluation environments around each company’s workflows and data.

Continuous learning turns each company’s expertise into a compounding asset. Completed work, corrections, and employee feedback improve the agents, and those improvements carry into future jobs. The business preserves its knowledge while becoming more capable over time.

As these agents take on more workflows, Faraday will be the shared runtime coordinating work between humans, agents, and robots across the business.
long_description.after:
Industrial and legacy enterprises still rely on people to coordinate disconnected layers of software and machines. Automating this work has required an FDE services approach in the past, because so much of it is bespoke and company specific.

long_description.before:
Armorer helps companies in regulated industries ship their own AI agents faster and keep them secure in production.

Most security tools flag an issue and file a ticket. Armorer assesses your agent and simulates attacks to find the real issues. Then it creates a verified fix that stops the attack without breaking the business, ready for your approval in about 4 hours.

In production, Armorer checks every agent action in milliseconds, with no GPU needed. It detects malicious behavior such as prompt injection, goal hijacking and data leaks, then allows, holds or denies the action.

Armorer's detection models beat every other detector we tested on six public benchmarks. Armorer is 22% more accurate than JEV while being 88x faster, so users won't feel the delay.

We spent years building and evaluating AI security systems together at AWS, including its first customer-facing AI security agent, which scaled to 100k+ customers. Armorer is backed by Paul Vixie, an internet pioneer inducted into the Internet Hall of Fame in 2014.

long_description.before: twentyfour26 builds autonomous CNC machining cells for rapid prototyping, so hardware teams can iterate with software speed.
long_description.after:
At twentyfour26, we are developing standardized manufacturing cells that bring machines, tooling, workholding, and inspection under a single system. Our models are being developed to interpret CAD designs, plan machining strategies, select tooling and setups, and operate the machines.

We're already manufacturing components for hardware companies in and around the Bay Area, with turnaround times as fast as ~48 hours. Operating our own machines allows us to develop and deploy automation against real production workloads.

Our goal is to make manufacturing 100 different designs as easy as manufacturing 100 units of the same design.

From individual components to complete assemblies, we want to abstract the entire manufacturing infrastructure into an API.

one_liner.after: Building Autonomous Factories in America, Starting with On-Demand CNC…

long_description.before: Halmos Labs builds automated biotech R&D on the principles of validity and interpretabillity. We run research, and simulations answering open questions ranging from wetlab experiment design to full cancer vaccine manufacturing.
long_description.after:
Halmos Labs rebuilds the drug development infrastructure around agents. To prove the future, we are aiming to have our AI be the first to bring a drug to market, and have already brought a cancer vaccine, and a new antibiotic, to the lab with results expected in mid December. 

Physical validation is the main bottleneck of scientific research agents. Existing labs already have capacity, yet experiments remain difficult to access and coordinate. Halmos Labs plans experiments, and enables access to physical validation. Connecting to Halmos, every agent can close the loop on R&D without leaving the terminal.

long_description.before:
Build agents that research accounts, find prospects, run campaigns, update your CRM, qualify inbound, and more. Connect them to the systems you already use and let them work alongside your GTM team.

Engineer your revenue factory on Frontrunner.
long_description.after:
Frontrunner lets GTM teams describe the work they need done and deploy agents that run it, connected to their existing tools and data. Our customers are building agents for everything from inbound lead routing to signal-based outbound and multi-touch attribution. Think Cursor for GTM: the place to engineer your revenue factory. 

GTM engineers and rev ops teams spend their days stitching tools together; and fielding requests from sales and marketing. Each campaign has its own version of who the customer is, what makes a lead qualified, and which signals matter. When the business changes, someone has to update that logic everywhere. Even teams that can build their own tools end up depending on the person who built them to keep everything running.

Not only does Frontrunner give those agents a shared understanding of your ICP, customers, and gtm motion, but persists that shared understanding automatically when business context changes so that it remains in sync. Sales and marketing build, run, and manage agents against that shared context, using the tools they already know. As prospects move from first touch to closed deal, the results feed back into how agents target, qualify, and engage the next account. Your revenue factory gets smarter with every cycle, optimizing for conversion across the full sales journey.

Our customers range from AI native startups to agencies running GTM for their clients to established businesses supporting large sales teams. They use Frontrunner to turn their best plays into agents their whole team can use.

long_description.before:
Tilo is a Linux-based operating system built for AI agents to work alongside people. On Tilo, computer use is up to 10,000x cheaper than on a normal OS.

Today agents use computers the way people do. They take screenshots and click through apps, which is slow, expensive, and brittle. In Tilo, every app exports actions, so agents work over MCP while people use the UI. You still see what each agent does in your apps, and anything it changes can be undone.

Any number of people and agents can work in one workspace in real time, across apps. Tilo runs as your OS, in our cloud, or headless on your machine, and you can open and share any workspace from the browser.
long_description.after:
Tilo gives AI agents one shared computer. Today every agent gets its own virtual machine and works by screenshots and clicks, which is slow, expensive and brittle. Agents that work together have to describe what they did to each other in messages.

Tilo is a Linux-based operating system built for agents as users. Every app exports typed actions that agents call over MCP while people use the same actions as buttons, on the same live state. Many agents work in one workspace at once and read each other's work instead of messaging about it. Every change is attributed and can be undone, and irreversible actions need permission. Because state and interface are separate, agents can generate an app's entire UI on demand.

On the same multi-app task with the same model, agents on Tilo were about 29× cheaper and 90× faster than computer use, which failed. A small model on Tilo did it for about 1/10,000 of the frontier model's cost. In our scale test, 50 agents worked in one shared workspace on a single laptop, at about 60 MB of memory per agent. Tilo runs headless, in our cloud, or as a desktop, and you can open any workspace from the browser.

one_liner.after: The Microsoft of the AI era: the operating system for AI agents.
